title: Preserve Windows folder picker's last-used location
outcome: Accepted UX follow-up from Claude7199: create_dialog calls SetFolder(default_workdir), forcing initial location each open. Microsoft SetFolder docs confirm it overrides MRU; SetDefaultFolder preserves recent location with fallback. Consider switching the initial seed to SetDefaultFolder, update native test expectations, and verify repeated opens outside default workdir. Separate from foreground/DPI verification; no current implementation or deployment authorization. Reference https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/shobjidl_core/nf-shobjidl_core-ifiledialog-setfolder
